text: General Information:Students are required to complete the curriculum between 4 years and fulfill the designated number of credits.Successful graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with the bachelor\'s degree, according to the regulation of the Degree Committee of the People\'s Republic of China.One who has failed to meet the academic requirements will be issued a certificate of completion of studies provided this is in conformity with the relevant regulations.Note:1. Textbook fees: based on the prices of the books.2. Students who need the Chinese Government scholarship should apply to the Education Commission of China through related governmental department of their respective countries. Self-supporting students should apply directly from the Admission Department of Foreign Students Office.
